home_faqs.q: What is the lowest price any of these six brands prints today?
home_faqs.a: Wahl's own pet grooming store prints the lowest figure: a hair clipper blade oil at $5.99, then a waterless no-rinse dog shampoo at $7.99 and six dog shampoo formulas at $9.99. The cheapest grooming tool is that $9.99 shampoo or a $11.99 dog nail clipper, and the cheapest clipper is Andis's Easy Clip Starter Kit at $39.99. All read on 2026-09-30.

home_faqs.q: Which of these brands publish prices on their own site?
home_faqs.a: Four do: Andis, Wahl, TropiClean and Chris Christensen all print prices in their own stores. Two do not: XPOWER and Nature's Miracle print product facts but no dollar figures, and both route buyers to a 'WHERE TO BUY' step instead - so this site reports 'not published on the official site' for them rather than guessing a price.

home_faqs.q: Do the official stores offer free shipping?
home_faqs.a: Three publish a threshold: Andis prints 'FREE SHIPPING ON ORDERS $50+', Wahl prints 'FREE SHIPPING ON ORDERS $25+', and TropiClean prints 'FREE Standard Shipping on Orders $22+'. Chris Christensen prints 'Free Shipping on orders over $50. Was $100. Use Code: FREESHIP50.' - so its $50 threshold is conditional on that code.

home_faqs.q: Are these official prices discounted right now?
home_faqs.a: Some are. TropiClean's shampoo grid prints sale prices against struck-through regular prices ($3.00 to $10.00 off on the items read), and Chris Christensen's banner shows a shipping-threshold promotion with the code FREESHIP50. Andis and Wahl printed list prices with no strike-through on the pages read. Promotions change without notice - check the linked page before you buy.

home_faqs.q: How much does a pet clipper cost on the brand's own site?
home_faqs.a: Andis prints $39.99 for an Easy Clip Starter Kit, $49.99 to $79.99 for the Dr. Pol Easy Clip line, $119.99 for the enVISION Cordless Clipper Pet, $159.99 for the ProClip 5-in-1 WILD and $239.99 for the EMERGE Lite Clipper. Every fact on this site was read from the brand's own official page - its store, product page or policy page - on the date shown next to it, and carries the exact URL it came from. Nothing is taken from a comparison site, and no price is estimated: where a brand does not publish a figure, the page says so.
